dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with no measurable curvature; fits a single straight vector due to low-poly geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex point with no measurable radius (sharp angle).
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin at approximately 60 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.1 times the vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Polygonal convex arc with visible linear facets approximating a curved melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum with a length-to-base thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 155 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon 3D mesh rendering with visible faceted edges and artificial specular highlights on the dorsal surface.
